vo_open.text: In 1962, a laughter epidemic shut down fourteen schools.

vo.text: It started at a girls' boarding school in Kashasha, in today's Tanzania.
vo.cap: It started at a *girls' boarding school* in Kashasha.

vo.text: Soon, ninety-five of its hundred and fifty-nine students were affected.
It spread to nearby villages. About a thousand people. Fourteen schools closed.
vo.cap: It spread. About *1,000 people.* *14 schools* closed.

vo.text: It lasted about eighteen months. Experts call it mass psychogenic illness.
